siteTagline: Full-text search across Robbinsdale Area Schools board meeting agendas, minutes, and packets.
_comment_scope: Agenda + minutes text is indexed for ALL meetings (cheap). Attachment PDF text is only fetched for meetings on/after attachmentsSinceDate, because the full archive is ~15GB and site.db must download to every visitor.
_comment_limits: Guardrails so a runaway run cannot hammer BoardBook or explode the database.
_comment_courtesy: Politeness settings. requestDelayMs is the minimum gap between requests to boardbook.org.
userAgent: BoardBookSearchBot/0.1 (+https://github.com/OWNER/boardbook-search; public records indexing; contact: OWNER@example.com)
_comment_ocr: OCR fallback runs only if a PDF page yields almost no extractable text AND the tesseract binary is available on PATH. Disabled by default because it is slow.
